prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, finish copy, finish notification, home new_flow, sign_in copy, sign_in hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were effective, winning in 2 of 3 tests.
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 2 of 7 tests (+4.2% and +3.9%), while 5 other tests showed no clear effect.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, and home notification changes across 2 tests each.
Adoption redesign (3 tests), choose_path copy (3 tests), adoption hint (2 tests), sign_in notification (2 tests), and sign_in reorder (2 tests) hurt performance or showed no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Voice & Speech Guided Flow: Add an interactive voice command practice flow on the home_intro screen where users can speak and test basic pet commands right before completing setup. (why: Interactive finish flows won in 2 out of 3 past experiments, and support received multiple complaints from users unclear on how to talk to or control their pets.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Selection Card Grid Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a grid layout featuring character audio previews and highlighted pet traits. (why: The adoption step has the lowest step conversion in the funnel (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s); a clearer visual selection grid helps users decide faster.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Control & Visibility Quick-Guide Screen: Add a new dedicated screen after home_intro explaining shortcut keys to hide, dock, summon, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support logs show 3 emails regarding confusion over hiding/controlling pets and 4 emails about feature controls post-onboarding.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Care Companion Idle Activity Mini-Flow: Introduce an interactive pet feeding and care mini-activity directly into the waiting screen while desktop assets render in the background. (why: The waiting stage in the home step has a very high mean time (2336s). Active engagement keeps users entertained while background rendering completes.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Re-Sign-In Account Continuity & Pet Persistence Copy: Update headline and body on the sign_in screen to explicitly explain that logging into an existing account restores and preserves existing pet data. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported missing or reset pets after signing back in, causing churn at sign-in (72.9% step conversion).)
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Progress & Desktop Stage Checklist: Update the waiting screen to display real-time rendering stage progress and step count indicators. (why: Home wait_info improvements previously yielded positive lifts (+4.2% and +3.9%), reassuring users during long generation processes.)
6: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Lighting and Pose Preparation Hint: Add hint text on upload_photos detailing lighting and camera angles for optimal pet photo rendering. (why: Support received 3 bug reports about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect, which contributes to drop-off in the adoption step.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Clear Desktop Companion Mode Selection Value Copy: Rewrite the headline and body on choose_path to clearly distinguish between instant adoption of ready pets and custom photo pet creation. (why: Choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate and a mean time of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation or confusion on path selection.)
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Complete Notification Switch: Enable notify_when_ready and alert hints on home_intro so users are notified as soon as their pet appears on their desktop. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not appearing on desktop or users missing the desktop spawn event during finish setup.)
